newsitem.title: UK: UK fire union says ban Channel Tunnel open wagons.
newsitem.headline: UK fire union says ban Channel Tunnel open wagons.

text.p: The UK Fire Brigade Union published a separate and damning report into last November's Channel Tunnel fire and called for a permanent ban to be placed on the open-sided freight wagons which were attributed with creating a "blow-torch effect" in last year's blaze.

In its list of recommendations, the union said: "The use of semi-open rail wagons for the transport of LGVs should be permanently prohibited within the Channel Tunnel." The union report coincides with the Channel Tunnel Safety Authority's final report which criticises Eurotunnel Plc but stops short of calling for a wagon redesign.
The head of Kent Fire Brigade, Jeremy Beech who sits on the safety authority committee, has also said he is concerned about the safety of the wagons.
The union will be pressing its concerns with John Prescott, deputy prime minister and head of transport and the environment in the new Labour government.
